notes.title: What?! The Next Apocalypse Party Game is... a Card Roguelike?!
notes.content:
Oi~ Long time no see, folks!

Miss those days of blasting demons [strike]while picking up trash[/strike]? Don't worry, your old friends at Breaker Games are back to stir things up again!

Remember that apocalyptic tavern you loved to hate? Yep, we're back where it all began. But this time, we're swapping bullets for... cards!

We're thrilled to introduce our brand-new game—
[h2]Apokerlypse!![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43983033/e59f182c7e225f57c1ba883d37ad0a71d5333235.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43983033/0148122bdc3e614b7a39b0ae5a46eaa60419edf9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43983033/fc14326a8a188391e7cf6142e2fa1aee359bff3a.png[/img]

It's a [b]card strategy roguelike[/b] inspired by classic poker games, but we've twisted the rules into something completely wild! (In the best way possible, of course!)

Here, you'll play as a uniquely skilled post-apocalyptic card shark, using wacky [Demon Chips] to bend the rules, combining them with slick [Hero Abilities] and powerful [Spell Cards] to outwit and outplay player ghosts (data from real players) from around the globe!

Simply put: Your favorite weirdos (heroes) from Apocalypse Party are back, but the game's completely flipped! Forget PVE bullet hell – this is asynchronous PvP madness at the card table! Real friends settle scores with cards, right? Bring it on!

[h3]OK, the REALLY important stuff (pay attention!)[/h3]
[b]▶ New Title Reveal![/b] The Steam store page for Apokerlypse is LIVE NOW! Go check it out, and PLEASE hit that Wishlist button! Wishlist it! Wishlist it! Please！
     ✧ Apokerlypse Steam Store Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3481020/_/
[b]▶ Global Playtest Starts NOW![/b] Wanna try this "unconventional" card game early? We've got 1000 limited spots for the Global Playtest! Yep, usual deal: first come, first served! Head to the new store page NOW to request access, get a sneak peek, and then smash that feedback button to tell us EVERYTHING!
     ✧ Request Playtest Access via the store page link above!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43983033/7ffd3ccc721a94fdac0e92611b977467bd67259e.png[/img]

[h3]Finally, a massive thank you for all your patience and for sticking with us. [/h3]
Apokerlypse is a completely new take on the Apocalypse Party universe, and we genuinely hope it brings you a different kind of chaotic fun!

OK, enough talk. Same old tavern, brand new game! Looking forward to getting absolutely crushed by your crazy strategies (or maybe schooling you vets myself)!

[h2]The new party starts NOW![/h2]

Cheers,
The Entire Breaker Games Team
(Hopefully, we'll lose less hair this time...)

notes.title: The producer's heartfelt words, and a preview of...Workshop!
notes.content:
Hey there, everyone!

I'm Wilson Lin, the producer of "Apocalypse Party," you might have seen my name lurking in the background. Today, I'd like to share some heartfelt words with you.

Recently, we've had a lot of new players join "Apocalypse Party," and many have left valuable reviews. I sincerely appreciate every player and every comment. Whether it's positive or negative, your feedback helps make our game better.

But what I really want to say is,
[b]Our recent reviews have shot up to "Very Positive"!!! Yay!![/b]
Of course, I know that even now, "Apocalyptic Party" is not a game that fully deserves "Overwhelmingly Positive" reviews. There will still be moments in the game that drive you crazy, [b]and we will keep fixing and optimizing![/b]

I also have some good news to share with you:
[h2]Our next stop is Steam Workshop![/h2]
Although developing Workshop has been much more difficult than imagined, as a producer, I am incredibly excited to see everyone's talents in the game.
So, we will do our utmost to let everyone express creativity and share the fun here!

Finally, I want to say, whether you are happy or not, you are always welcome to return to "Apocalypse Party." 

[h3]Here, there is always a group of friends willing to accompany you through thick and thin.[/h3]

Alright, that's enough talk.
Let the party begin!

Wilson Lin

notes.title: Finally! 99.899% of Crash Issues Resolved!
notes.content:
Dear "Apocalypse Party" players, I am Wilson, the producer.

Allow me to start with a long sigh of relief:
[h3]Ah! The crash issue that has been troubling us for over a month has finally been resolved!![/h3]

I know we've claimed to have fixed the crashes several times before, and it might have started to seem unbelievable. That's why we didn't rush to announce this time. Instead, we observed for a week after releasing the version last Monday.

Today, after confirming through data that the crash rate has significantly decreased, we dare to announce this great news!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43983033/da95256644d2026d071d14f8b14b921f341c290f.png[/img]

Our "crash-free game sessions" ratio has now risen to 
[h3]99.899%.[/h3]
[i]Note: There might be some errors and fluctuations in data statistics. However, there's definitely a significant improvement, as the worst situation was around 96%.[/i]

Although this fix came later than expected, and many players left our game because of it, I want to say that we never stopped addressing these issues that affect player experience; it was just more challenging than anticipated.

Here, I apologize to those players who did not have a good experience due to the "crashes," and I want to 

[h2]thank those who have continuously supported and tolerated us.[/h2]

In addition to "crashes," today's version also resolved the following issues:
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue of talents being auto-selected in online mode.
[*] Fixed the problem where the hidden effects feature was ineffective on projectile effects.
[*] Fixed the issue where completing the "Prologue" did not unlock the King.
[*] Fixed intermittent inability to attack among teammates caused by "Earth" and "Gunpowder Trap" equipment in online mode.
[*] Fixed the issue where "Surface Brothers" and "Butt Princess" could not transfer curses to teammates.
[*] Fixed the problem of "Master Yi" not regenerating health.
[*] Fixed the issue where activating "Shadow Scythe" activated the soul tag pool.
[/list]
After resolving the major headache of "crashes," our team can finally focus more on producing subsequent updates.

We already have many exciting plans, and the specific update schedule will be announced this week. Please stay tuned!

Lastly, I want to thank everyone for your support and understanding of "Apocalypse Party." We will continue to strive to provide a higher quality gaming experience. If you encounter any problems in the game or have any suggestions, please feel free to provide us with feedback!


Wilson and the "Apocalypse Party" team

notes.title: URGENT ANNOUNCEMENT: Online Room Search Issue, Development Team Actively Working
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are issuing an urgent announcement. Approximately half an hour after the game launch, we encountered a significant issue due to the overwhelming number of players joining our online multiplayer mode. Our system is currently struggling to cope with high traffic. 😢

We must address this issue head-on. Despite conducting extensive tests prior to the launch, we did not anticipate that the influx of a large number of users would cause our multiplayer rooms to crash. This oversight was on our part, and we want to be transparent with our players about the cause of the issue, presenting the situation as it is:

Our game uses P2P (peer-to-peer) for multiplayer connections; hence, this issue is not related to server capacity.

The game lobby utilizes Steam's existing lobby logic as we have integrated with Steam's interface.
There may be some issues with our integration logic, which seem to be causing the lobby to crash when a massive number of players join.

Our team is currently working rapidly to identify and resolve the problem. We will push updates as soon as a solution is found.

While it's a bit embarrassing, we suggest players experiencing issues with multiplayer try the single-player mode to familiarize themselves with the game. We understand this doesn't solve the main issue, but we hope not to lose your support. Please rest assured that we are committed to fixing these issues.
We sincerely thank all our players for your support!!! 

Our entire development and operations team at Apocalypse Party is working tirelessly on this.


Best regards,
The Apocalypse Party Development and Operations Team

Thanks to our dedicated team, "Apocalypse Party" now boasts [b]30 characters[/b], [b]90 skills[/b], a massive weapon range, and [b]300 unique talents[/b]. But we're not stopping there!

To celebrate your continuous support, we're launching the "Milestone" event. For each wishlist or sales goal we hit, we'll unlock new rewards. Everyone with the official game gets them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43983033/579d592466dc74b010c3074c596011e305a208a9.jpg[/img]

Stay updated on Steam or our social media. Rewards are coming your way!

notes.title: Exciting News for Our Indie Game Lovers! 🚀
notes.content:
Mark your calendars! "Project Zero 2: Apocalypse Party" is gearing up to hit Steam in the fourth quarter of 2023! Our team is pouring their heart and soul into every pixel, every line of code, to ensure you guys get the best gaming experience.

Make sure you add it to your wishlist and stay tuned! Can't wait to share our hard work with all of you awesome gamers out there!

notes.title: Coming 2023: Dive into the Next Chapter with ‘Project Zero 2: Apocalypse Party’!
notes.content:
'Project Zero' is not the end but rather the gateway to 'Project Zero 2: Apocalypse Party'. 

Here, you'll experience an array of brand-new combat styles, meet companions of diverse personalities but with a unified goal. Whether you choose to go solo or team up for battle, the choice is yours. 

But it's not just you and your friends who are growing stronger. Unprecedented and fierce enemies await your challenge!

Whether you're a new companion looking to join or an old friend aiming to fulfill an unfinished mission, we look forward to meeting you in 'Project Zero 2: Apocalypse Party'!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43983033/3e225fe22ffccc94b17cbc5481388cf2484e633f.png[/img]

notes.title: New Project Zero Game Is Coming
notes.content:
Attention, attention, and welcome to the new Project Zero sequel: [b]Project Zero 2: Apocalypse[/b]. Please follow the order and visit civilly.

In Project Zero 2: Apocalypse, whether you are an experienced warrior or a newcomer, you can travel through time and space and return to the fantastic Middle Ages! This time, you can not only challenge the nightmare-like enemies alone but also join hands with your companions and save the world from the doomsday crisis!

The skills of Project Zero 2: Apocalypse will be more than 10 times that of the previous game, and at least 300+ skills, hundreds of which are mechanism types! Massive entries and free combinations will bring rich and varied combat methods! Let’s master our spells and create a unique combat experience!

You can find all our contact information in the player community, join us and share your game experience with everyone!
